name: Cloud misconfiguration remediation
description: Respond to a cloud-posture (CSPM) finding that flags a sensitive misconfiguration: public storage exposure, over-permissive identity, missing encryption, or a deviating baseline. The playbook enriches the finding with resource ownership, notifies the responsible owner via the operator's pre-bound channel, guides the remediation through an attested change, and re-scans to verify the fix. Failed re-scans escalate so a recurring misconfiguration cannot quietly persist. CACAO v2 + SecOps-NG content-model extensions.

__finding_id__.description: Identifier of the originating CSPM / posture finding supplied by the detection layer.

__resource_id__.description: Cloud resource identifier (URN / ARN / resource-id) the finding is bound to. Resolved during enrichment.

__owner_id__.description: Identity (team or individual) accountable for the resource per the operator's ownership graph. Drives owner notification.

__severity__.description: Resolved severity of the finding after enrichment (informational, low, medium, high, critical). Drives SLA timers via the metrics layer.

__known_false_positive__.description: True when the finding matches a documented exception or a known-benign baseline-deviation record within the suppression window. False routes into owner notification.

__remediation_verified__.description: Outcome of the post-remediation re-scan. True closes the case; false branches into escalation.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: ingest finding
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Fetch the CSPM / posture finding from the operator's posture-management platform: rule fingerprint, affected resource, evaluated baseline, first-observed timestamp. Source is identified by __finding_id__ and may originate from continuous CSPM scans or from an IaC policy guardrail emitting the same OCSF shape at deploy time.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: enrich resource and owner
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Resolve the affected resource against the cloud inventory and ownership graph: tenant, project / account, region, resource type, tags, accountable owner, classification. Produces __resource_id__, __owner_id__, and __severity__ (severity is resolved here rather than ingested raw because the operator's classification can lift or lower the upstream CSPM severity).

if-condition--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00.name: known false positive?
if-condition--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00.description: Suppression branch. on_success: the finding matches a documented exception (compensating-control attestation, time-boxed exception record) or an already-seen baseline-deviation fingerprint within the suppression window; suppress-and-close. on_failure: continue into owner notification.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: suppress and close
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Link the finding to its existing exception or known-deviation record, close the case without paging, and account the suppression against the recurring-misconfiguration KRI so a chronically suppressed posture rule surfaces in the metrics layer.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: notify owner
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Notify the resource owner along the operator's pre-bound channel (ticketing / chat / paging, per __severity__). The notification carries the finding, the affected resource, the violated baseline, and a link to the guided-remediation runbook the next step references.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: guided remediation
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Apply the remediation bound to the violated baseline rule, with change-management attestation: either an operator-approved auto-remediation hand-off (IaC pull request, runbook execution) or an owner-driven manual change captured against the change record. The action body is operator-bound; only the contract (a remediation attempt is recorded against the finding) is fixed by this playbook.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: re-scan
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Trigger a targeted re-scan against the same baseline rule and resource. Emits __remediation_verified__ based on whether the rule still fires. The re-scan is a deterministic verification step, not a fresh posture sweep.

if-condition--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00.name: remediation verified?
if-condition--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00.description: Branch on __remediation_verified__. on_success: re-scan confirms the rule no longer fires; close the case. on_failure: remediation did not stick — escalate so the recurring-misconfiguration KRI captures the residual exposure rather than closing on an unverified attempt.

action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: escalate
action--30000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Escalate to the security-engineering on-call along the operator's pre-bound paging channel. The escalation payload carries the finding, the attempted remediation, and the failing re-scan evidence. Tracked against the recurring-misconfiguration KRI so chronic unremediated posture exceptions surface in the metrics layer.
